# Charts still republished under the same version by their repositories. update-index.yml
# lets these be overwritten or deleted on master; every other chart is append-only there,
# so a published version never changes. Remove a chart from this list once its repository
# publishes through publish-chart with a new version for each release (and the dev channel
# from its main branch).
#
#   kubevirt-xpu-device-plugin  kubevirt-xpu-device-plugin-helm republishes 3.5.0 from main
#   pulley-spider               pulley-spider-helm commits pulley-spider-3.5.0.tgz from master
kubevirt-xpu-device-plugin
pulley-spider
